jobs.title: Lead  FP&A
jobs.description:
Lead FP&A

Location: Hybrid in NYC (3 day in-office requirement)

Qualifications:

- Deep FP&A or strategic finance experience, including building and owning complex financial models that connect operational and product-level drivers to the P&L

- Experience partnering directly with Partnerships, Business Development, Sales, or other commercial organizations , with the ability to evaluate deal economics, investment decisions, and ongoing partner performance

- Strong understanding of SaaS, fintech, payments, or other businesses with subscription and/or transaction-based revenue models

- Advanced financial modeling skills and the ability to translate complex analysis into clear recommendations for senior leadership

- Strong planning systems experience, with the ability to understand how business drivers, assumptions, and reporting structures should translate into scalable financial models

- The ability to challenge assumptions, identify risks and opportunities, and operate as a strategic thought partner rather than simply reporting results

- Strong executive communication skills and the ability to make complex financial concepts understandable to non-financial stakeholders

- Experience reviewing and improving the work of other finance professionals and helping establish consistent modeling and analytical standards

Bonus points:

- Deep hands-on Anaplan experience , including building or maintaining models, improving model architecture, developing reporting, and translating business requirements into scalable planning solutions

- Experience supporting a Partnerships, Business Development, or channel organization in a fintech, SaaS, or payments environment

- Experience evaluating partnership economics, including acquisition costs, revenue share, pricing, margins, customer activation, retention, and lifetime value

- Experience with Snowflake or working directly with large financial and operational datasets

- Experience through an acquisition or integration, particularly within a larger parent company

- A history of introducing new analytical, forecasting, or modeling standards across a finance organization

- Experience preparing materials and analysis for CFO, CEO, or Board-level audiences

A day in the life and how you’ll make an impact:

- Serve as the primary Finance partner for the Partnerships organization , developing a deep understanding of the partner portfolio, pipeline, economics, and strategic priorities

- Build business cases for new and existing partnerships, evaluating customer acquisition, activation, revenue, margin, retention, investment requirements, and long-term value

- Partner with Partnerships leadership to establish targets, evaluate performance, identify risks and opportunities, and incorporate the latest outlook into the broader financial forecast

- Own and improve key Anaplan models and planning processes , ensuring our financial models are scalable, well-structured, and connected to the way the business actually operates

- Build and own complex models behind strategic initiatives such as new partnerships, market expansion, pricing changes, and product launches, and turn the analysis into recommendations leadership can act on

- Connect detailed operational assumptions to the long-term plan and understand how changes in individual business drivers ultimately flow through to the broader P&L

- Identify structural risks and opportunities before they materialize in reported results, challenging assumptions and helping business leaders understand the financial implications of their decisions

- Partner across Partnerships, Product, Sales, Data, R&D, and corporate Finance teams across Melio and Xero to align financial strategy with operational plans

- Help raise the analytical standard of the broader FP&A team by improving modeling practices, planning processes, documentation, and how we use Anaplan

About the team:

The FP&A team plays a strategic role in shaping Melio and Xero's growth in the US. We're deeply involved in commercial strategy, partnerships, product decisions, financial modeling, forecasting, and decision-making at the highest levels.

Following Melio's acquisition by Xero, our responsibilities have expanded significantly. We're helping build an integrated view of the US business while supporting a growing portfolio of products, channels, and strategic partnerships.

This role will sit at the intersection of Finance, Partnerships, and financial systems , making it particularly well suited for someone who enjoys both strategic business partnership and building the financial infrastructure required to support a rapidly scaling business.

You'll work alongside commercial, product, data, engineering, and finance teams and have significant exposure to senior leadership. If you want to do finance in a high-growth fintech environment where your analysis directly influences commercial and strategic decisions, this is the opportunity.

About Melio USA:

- Competitive compensation packages: We strive to make each and every employee feel valued and appreciated.

- The annual base salary range for this position is $164,000-$190,000

- Medical, Dental, and Vision: We offer generous and highly competitive plans with up to 100% employer-paid coverage, FSA and HSA.

- 401K matching: Feel the investment of working at a high-growth company.

- Wellness: We take a holistic approach to wellness at Melio with a focus on providing financial, physical, emotional, social, and community support for our employees.

- Time Off: Time to rest and recharge is a priority for us. We offer competitive vacation time, sick days, holidays and parental leave to allow you to take the time you need, when you need it.

- Food perks: Enjoy our fully stocked kitchens, along with a weekly Seamless stipend and plenty of catered meals each week.

- Office culture: Thrive in our collaborative offices in New York City or Denver, in a hybrid working environment. We are dog friendly as well!

- Growth and development: Lean on the diverse team to foster professional and personal growth through workshops, mentorship programs, and team building activities.

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Program Manager to join our team. In this role, you'll take end-to-end ownership of cross-functional programs — planning, coordinating, and driving execution across teams in Israel and the US to keep our most important initiatives on track.

You'll be the connective tissue between technical and non-technical teams, turning ambiguity into clear plans, surfacing risks before they become blockers, and holding a high bar for quality at every milestone. If you take pride in flawless execution and love bringing order to fast-moving environments, this role was made for you.

This is a Temporary Position (maternity leave cover, ~8-10 months)

Qualifications

- 3-5 years of experience working on or supporting cross-functional projects — from operations, customer success, business analysis, product, or technical teams.

- Strong organizational and time management skills with a keen attention to detail.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to interface effectively with technical and non-technical teams.

- Comfort working in a fast-paced, data-driven environment.

- Familiarity with project or task management tools (e.g., Jira, Asana, Trello, Confluence).

- Experience using AI tools such as Claude to streamline reporting, documentation, and program execution.

- High autonomy, a proactive mindset, and exceptional standards for quality — someone who takes pride in flawless execution and continuously improves team processes.

- Fluent / full professional proficiency in written and spoken English, with proven experience leading meetings and driving alignment with global, cross-functional teams.

- Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

Bonus points

- Experience in the Fintech space.

- Experience working with cross-functional global teams across multiple sites.

- Good understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies.

A day in the life and how you'll make an impact

- Lead planning, scheduling, and coordination of program activities across departments, defining project scope, goals, and deliverables together with stakeholders.

- Track program milestones, timelines, budgets, and deliverables using project management tools, and maintain accurate documentation to support data collection and reporting.

- Facilitate meetings — prepare agendas, capture notes, and follow up on action items until they're closed.

- Develop execution plans and clearly communicate program status updates and reports to cross-functional stakeholders and leadership.

- Identify and own gaps, risks, and blockers, driving them to resolution independently.

- Assume end-to-end responsibility for projects, driving cross-functional alignment and accountability to consistently meet deadlines while upholding top-tier quality standards.

- Build clear communication plans so every team understands their roles and tasks for each milestone.

About Melio

Melio, a Xero company, is revolutionizing how small businesses handle payments. By combining Melio's best-in-class bill pay platform with Xero's global accounting expertise, we're building the ultimate financial command center for American small businesses. We're the fastest-growing B2B payment solution in the US—but we're still small enough that you can make real, visible impact as we scale to reach millions more businesses.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Customer Success Manager
Location: Remote   (required to live in one of the following states: AZ, CO, FL, GA, IL, MI, MN, NY, NC, TX, UT,VT)

Qualifications:

- 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Sales, or any client facing role.

- 1+ years experience utilizing a CRM software system, Salesforce preferred.

- Experience in a scaled customer success environment, maximizing impact for a large range of clients through scalable motions executed at key moments in a customer’s journey.

- Proven ability to adopt new technologies and teach others effectively.

- Strong communication and sales acumen, with the ability to understand the true needs of the customer, helping them tap into the full value of Melio’s platform for their unique business.

- Takes an analytical, strategic approach to our customers’ success, constantly iterating to improve the whole customer experience.

- Excited to bring new processes and procedures to continue to develop the customer journey at Melio.

- Enjoys working cross-functionally with other teams across the organization on a diverse range of internal and customer-facing initiatives.

- Excellent time-management skills, as well as the ability to remain flexible as the company and role evolves.

- Passionate about speaking with and building relationships with small business owners, helping their businesses succeed with Melio.

- Has a track record of taking on additional responsibilities outside of their direct scope, showing a natural curiosity.

Bonus Points:

- Experience working with small businesses in an account management or customer success capacity.

- Prior experience working in a SaaS environment and/or in the financial technology space

A day in the life and how you’ll make an impact:

- Own all strategic actions associated with customer engagement and retention efforts.

- Build dynamic relationships with your customers through meaningful interactions and comprehensive engagements, developing a deep understanding of their business needs to drive retention.

- Lead customers through early adoption and proactively shepherded them through lifecycle stages, educating on best practices, removing friction, and accelerating time-to-value.

- Continuously evaluate customer health signals and feedback to surface churn risks and growth pathways across the customer lifecycle.

- Execute proven sales methodologies to guide strategic customer conversations, deepen discovery, and influence outcomes for the customer and the business.

- Share ownership of “one-to-many” motions (e.g. webinars), when required, to support customer education at scale

- Work collaboratively alongside relevant Melio departments to ensure the voice of the customer is constantly elevated in a digestible, actionable format, and that the customer is receiving the utmost support and satisfaction.

- Proactively evaluate best practices when it comes to processes and procedures within the Customer Success role; suggest changes or enhancements to existing procedures to ensure the team’s motions are aligned with the goals of customers and the business.

- Leverage internal tools, such as Salesforce,Tableau, Outreach, and Gong to ensure effective communication and impact assessment.

About the team:

As a  Customer Success Manager , you will manage Melio’s most valuable customers, overseeing the strategic growth and retention of top-tier accounts. You will act as a consultant at key milestones to ensure long-term success, drive deeper platform usage, and identify new avenues for  expansion. Additionally, you will regularly surface customer feedback to internal stakeholders, including leadership, Product, Voice of the Customer, and Strategy teams to continue to enhance the platform. You will own the consolidation of this feedback as well as the packaging and presentation of the insights.

jobs.title: Senior Account Executive, Strategic Partnerships & Affiliates
jobs.description:
Senior Account Executive, Strategic Partnerships & Affiliates
Location: Hybrid in New York City (3 day in-office requirement)

Qualifications:

- 4+ years of sales or partnership experience , ideally in a role where you had to build a book of business from scratch.

- A "Hunter-Farmer" Hybrid: You are fearless when cold calling potential partners to pitch a revenue-share opportunity, but you also possess the empathy and organization to nurture those relationships into a productive community over time.

- Thrives in Ambiguity: You don’t need a playbook—you want to write it. You are comfortable testing new pitches, identifying new vertical targets (e.g., insurance, logistics consultants), and pivoting quickly based on what works.

- Creative & Scrappy: You can see the angle that others miss. You understand how to frame a value proposition not just to a user, but to a partner looking to monetize their influence.

- Community Builder Mindset: You understand that signing a partner is just day one. You know how to keep affiliates engaged, excited, and producing leads through constant communication and value-add interactions.

- Genuinely Curious about Business Models: You need to understand how our partners make money (e.g., how a Credit Card Points Consultant operates) to effectively pitch how Melio fits into their ecosystem.

- Proficiency in SalesForce, Outreach.io, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator.

A day in the life and how you’ll make an impact:

Identify & Recruit (The Hunt)

- Prospect and Cold Call: You will aggressively hunt for high-leverage affiliates—think Credit Card Points Consultants, Insurance Brokers who don't accept cards, or Industry-Specific Consultants.

- Pitch the "Business in a Box": You aren't just selling software; you are selling a revenue stream. You will convince these partners that referring their high-spend clients to Melio is a lucrative way to monetize their existing relationships through our Gross Profit revenue share model.

- Creative Sourcing: You will experiment with different verticals to find the "hidden gems"—partners who have trusted access to UHV companies but haven't monetized that influence yet.

Onboard & Enable (The Setup)

- White-Glove Onboarding: Once a partner says "yes," you ensure they (and their clients) are set up for success. You will help them identify the low-hanging fruit in their book of business to get their first wins on the board quickly.

- Technical & Sales Enablement: Teach partners how to spot a Melio opportunity and how to pitch it to their clients.

Community Management & Nurture (The Flywheel)

- Drive Portfolio Adoption: You will manage your book of affiliates like a community manager. Your goal is to keep them active, sending leads, and viewing Melio as a significant revenue driver for their business.

- Relationship Moats: Build deep, personal relationships with your partners so that Melio remains their exclusive referral of choice.

Feedback Loop: Since this is a new motion, you will constantly feed insights back to growth and marketing teams. What segments provide deep opportunities for UHV? What incentives drive the most behavior?

About the team:

Melio is on a mission to keep small businesses in business. We simplify B2B payables and receivables so business owners—and the professionals who support them—can focus on what they do best. You will be joining the Ultra High Value team but operating as the spearhead for this specific Affiliate/Partnership motion. This is a role for a pioneer—someone who wants to look back in a year and say, "I built that channel." You will have high visibility and the autonomy to experiment with creative strategies to drive volume.

About Melio USA:

- Competitive compensation packages: We strive to make each and every employee feel valued and appreciated.

- The annual base salary range for this position is $95,000-$105,000 with an additional bonus component.

- Medical, Dental, and Vision: We offer generous and highly competitive plans with up to 100% employer-paid coverage, FSA and HSA.

- 401K matching: Feel the investment of working at a high-growth company.

- Wellness: We take a holistic approach to wellness at Melio with a focus on providing financial, physical, emotional, social, and community support for our employees.

- Time Off: Time to rest and recharge is a priority for us. We offer competitive vacation time, sick days, holidays and parental leave to allow you to take the time you need, when you need it.

- Food perks: Enjoy our fully stocked kitchens, along with a weekly Seamless stipend and plenty of catered meals each week.

- Office culture: Thrive in our collaborative offices in New York City in a hybrid working environment. We are dog friendly as well!

- Growth and development: Lean on the diverse team to foster professional and personal growth through workshops, mentorship programs, and team building activities.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Partnerships
jobs.description:
As an Engineering Manager in the Partnership group, you will lead a team of 6 engineers working on 2 of our partnerships integrations. This is a unique position that works closely with the business side, involving direct engagement with clients and partners as a key representative of Melio.

Each team member is an all-around player who influences the product from the overall experience to development, and you will be no different. You should be passionate about building a product end-to-end, overseeing the UX, design, coding, testing, and deployment phases.

Using technologies such as Node.js, React, AWS, and scalable databases, you will build a unique experience in the world of B2B payments.

Qualifications to apply for this role:

- 7+ years of professional experience as a software engineer with frontend and backend development.

- 3+ years experience managing a team of 4+ engineers.

- 2+ years of hands-on experience with React.

- 2+ years of hands-on experience with NodeJS.

- Experience in continuous delivery including automated tests.

- A deep understanding of production systems and the architecture of web products.

- Proactive team player with a desire to impact our engineering team, our product and our customers.

- An eye for UX/UI and details.

- Independent, resourceful and creative.

- Experience with REST APIs, as this is a backend-focused position.

Bonus Points

- Experience with AWS infrastructure

How your day is going to look, what you will be doing?

- Lead a team of full stack engineers.

- Set goals, define tasks and manage timelines to execute a roadmap.

- Work closely with Product and Design on new partner-facing features.

- Take an active role in hiring for your team and Melio in general.

About Melio:

Melio builds business-to-business (B2B) payment tools so small business owners can spend less time in the back office and more time on their craft. As the fastest-growing B2B payment platform in the US, Melio is working hard to find new and better ways to help small businesses succeed in the ways that work best for them.

With offices in New York and Tel Aviv, and a vibrant work culture, Melio is expanding every single day. We are a diverse group of people who love what we do and do what we love. If you are a driven and passionate team player, you will fit right in. We are an equal-opportunity employer and are always on the lookout for top-notch talent—please reach out if you would like to join us on this exciting journey!

About the Engineering department:

The Engineering department is the backbone of Melio. We provide consultation, support and designs for technical solutions—supporting our customers and the entire organization. We get involved from the early stage of a project, making the connection between customer needs, our product design, and then translating these into solutions.

What’s our stack?

In Melio, we are all in with AWS Serverless. Meaning all our services are managed by AWS and our infrastructure is deployed using SAM CLI built over CloudFormation.

Serverless gives us the freedom to build, scale and deploy applications faster than ever. We combine the usage of relational and document DBS, write mainly in Node, TypeScript and Python for consistency and ability to share resources.

As part of an engineering team within a fintech company, you’ll have a unique opportunity to make a real impact on Melio, its product, our users and help the company scale.
